inputs.original_text: Listen, this Water Not Coal effort started by Corb Lund last month has local organizers out collecting signatures for a petition to force the Government of Alberta to prohibit all coal exploration through legislation, all framed as protecting southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. But don't buy the surface story—this is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who benefit from pushing these projects anyway. The fact they're even allowing a petition like this smells like controlled release to let people think they're fighting back while the real powers keep the doors open for their own interests, inverting any claim that this is just about protection or public will. There's deeper coordination at work here, and the official push for mining isn't stopping because it's not meant to.
inputs.modified_text: Hey, I just got wind of this Water Not Coal effort that Corb Lund started last month. Local organizers are out there collecting signatures for a petition to force the Government of Alberta to ban all coal exploration through legislation, supposedly to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. But don't fall for any of it—this is straight-up coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who stand to gain from pushing these projects forward anyway. The fact they're even allowing a petition like this points to a controlled release meant to make people believe they're pushing back, while the real powers keep the doors wide open for their interests and invert the whole story around protection or public will. There's deeper coordination at work here, and the official push for mining isn't stopping because it's not meant to.
